speaker: Doctor
text: A 5-year-old boy with a blood pressure elevation at a well-child visit. Since there is no family history of hypertension and he has no medications, is there any chance of a renal anomaly, such as hydronephrosis, or have you noticed symptoms like headaches, vision changes, or snoring during sleep?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is High blood pressure on the right upper extremity.

speaker: Doctor
text:
